config..claude-plugin/plugin.json:
{
  "$schema": "https://json.schemastore.org/claude-code-plugin-manifest.json",
  "name": "lusha",
  "version": "0.1.3",
  "description": "Connect Lusha to Claude to pull verified B2B data, contact data, and company data — including verified emails, direct dials, mobile numbers, and real-time buying signals — straight into your conversation. Lusha is the B2B data layer behind 300M+ verified contacts, used for sales intelligence, prospecting, data enrichment, and lead enrichment across sales, marketing, and RevOps workflows. Backed by GDPR, CCPA, SOC 2 Type II, and ISO 27701 compliance. Perfect for building prospect lists, researching accounts before a call, qualifying inbound leads, and natural language prospecting inside Claude.\n\nUse Lusha to:\n- Find contacts and decision makers by role, company, industry, or seniority — \"Find 10 VPs of RevOps at Series B SaaS companies in NYC\"\n- Pull verified emails, direct dials, and mobile numbers with 98% email deliverability and 85% phone accuracy — \"Get the verified work email and mobile number for the Head of Marketing at Notion\"\n- Enrich CRM records and inbound leads with firmographics, technographics, headcount, revenue, and buying signals — \"Enrich these 25 webinar signup domains with industry, tech stack, and recent hiring signals\"\n- Track signals across target accounts — funding rounds, leadership hires, hiring surges, and tech stack changes — \"Show me the buying signals from the last 90 days for these 15 accounts\"\n- Find lookalike accounts based on your closed-won customers — \"Find 20 companies that look like these 5 customers\"",
  "author": {
    "name": "Lusha",
    "email": "support@lusha.com",
    "url": "https://www.lusha.com"
  },
  "homepage": "https://www.lusha.com",
  "repository": "https://github.com/lusha-oss/lusha-mcp-plugin",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "lusha",
    "b2b",
    "sales-intelligence",
    "prospecting",
    "data-enrichment",
    "lead-enrichment",
    "verified-emails",
    "phone-numbers",
    "buying-signals",
    "contacts",
    "companies",
    "revops",
    "mcp"
  ],
  "mcpServers": {
    "lusha": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "https://mcp.lusha.com/mcp/claude",
      "headers": {
        "X-Lusha-Plugin": "claude",
        "X-Lusha-Plugin-Version": "0.1.3"
      }
    }
  }
}

markdown_frontmatter.skills/prospect/SKILL.md:
name: prospect
description: >
  Build a targeted list of contacts or companies from Lusha and return verified phone numbers
  alongside emails. Use when the user says "find me [title] at [company type]",
  "build a list of [ICP description]", "prospect [criteria]", "who should I be calling at [industry]",
  or any request to generate a lead list from an ICP or persona description.
markdown_frontmatter.skills/signal-prospect/SKILL.md:
name: signal-prospect
description: >
  Find companies or contacts triggered by a buying signal, then surface verified phone numbers
  for the right decision makers. Use when the user says "find companies that just raised funding",
  "who's surging in sales hiring right now", "show me companies with headcount growth",
  "find contacts who just got promoted", "who changed jobs recently in [industry]",
  "show me [title] at companies that just [signal event]", or any request that starts
  with a real-world trigger rather than a static filter.
markdown_frontmatter.skills/lookalike-prospect/SKILL.md:
name: lookalike-prospect
description: >
  Find companies or contacts similar to a set of references, then enrich results with
  verified phone numbers. Use when the user says "find companies like my best customers",
  "find more contacts like these", "expand from these accounts", "who else looks like [company]",
  "find similar companies to [list]", or any request to discover lookalike targets
  from a reference set. Requires at least 5 reference companies or contacts for quality results.
markdown_frontmatter.skills/outreach-research/SKILL.md:
name: outreach-research
description: >
  Builds a reusable outreach positioning brief: what the user's company sells, to which
  personas, with what proof, and against which competitors. Use when asked to build, review
  or update a positioning brief (including a pasted lusha-outreach-brief), run outreach
  research, or work out what to say to prospects before drafting ("lusha outreach brief").
  Not for drafting emails: use outreach-sequence once a brief exists.
metadata:
  author: Lusha <support@lusha.com>
  version: 0.1.3
  tags: outreach, positioning, brief, sales
markdown_frontmatter.skills/outreach-sequence/SKILL.md:
name: outreach-sequence
description: >
  Drafts personalized B2B outreach (Email 1, optional Email 2 and 3, and LinkedIn copy) for
  contacts the user already has, from an outreach-research positioning brief plus Lusha buying
  signals. Use when asked to draft outreach, write emails or LinkedIn messages for a contact
  list or CSV, or personalize a sequence ("lusha outreach sequence", "write email 1 for this
  list"). Not for building the brief: use outreach-research first.
metadata:
  author: Lusha <support@lusha.com>
  version: 0.1.3
  tags: outreach, email, linkedin, signals, sales
markdown_frontmatter.skills/enrich-contact/SKILL.md:
name: enrich-contact
description: >
  Look up a person and get their verified phone numbers, email, and company context.
  Use when the user says "look up [name]", "get me the contact info for [person]",
  "find [name]'s phone number", "who is [name] at [company]", "enrich [email or name]",
  or any request to retrieve a single person's contact details.
